description: Target elements for Exoplanet Codex abundance analysis — 27 targets (26 unique atomic symbols + Fe II as a separate entry). Fe I and Fe II use element='Fe' in the linelist; distinguished by the ion column. Priority 1 = science-critical (stellar characterisation + CHNOPS + alpha); Priority 2 = iron-peak/s-process/r-process tracers + bio-significant; Priority 3 = supplementary/age indicators.
note_fe: Fe I and Fe II are listed as separate entries to reflect distinct scientific roles: Fe I constrains Teff via excitation equilibrium; Fe II constrains log g via ionization equilibrium. build_linelist.py assigns priority via the 'Fe' symbol entry — Fe II inherits priority=1 automatically.

elements.science_notes: Fe I: Teff from excitation equilibrium (~50 clean lines). Fe II: log g from ionisation equilibrium (~10 lines). Primary metallicity anchor. Many NIST A-grade lines.
log g constraint via ionization equilibrium (~10 clean lines). Requires A(Fe I) = A(Fe II). In the linelist: element='Fe', ion='II'.
C/O ratio primary biosignature context. C I 5380 high-excitation line (7.685 eV). NLTE corrections from Amarsi et al. 2020.
[O I] 6300.304 forbidden line is primary indicator. Ni I 6300.336 blend must be subtracted (Allende Prieto+2001). NLTE corrections significant. THE critical line for C/O ratio.
Mg/Si mantle mineralogy indicator. Mg b triplet 5167-5183 Å strong reference lines. Mg/Fe traces SFR history. NLTE corrections small for dwarfs.
Rocky planet builder; major rock-forming element. Si/Fe and Mg/Si key for planetary interior modelling. Si I 5793 primary EW line.
Alpha tracer; Ca II H&K chromospheric activity. Ca I 6122/6162/6439 for photospheric abundance. Strong NIST A-grade data.
Alpha-like GCE tracer; refractory. Ti I/II many lines across HARPS range. Ti I 5866 primary reference. Ti I and Ti II useful for independent log g check.
Fe/Ni core composition proxy. Ni I 6300.336 is critical O I blend partner — must model jointly. Priority 1 due to O I blend correction requirement.
Bio-essential; biosignature context. Na I D lines strong but saturated. Weaker 5682/5688 doublet used for EW. NLTE corrections ~0.1 dex.
CHNOPS limiting nutrient for life. P I 6034/6043 weak (< 1% depth) — requires S/N > 300. NIST grade C. Only 2 usable lines in HARPS range.
CHNOPS volatile tracer; not depleted onto grains. S I 6052 high-excitation line (7.87 eV). S/Fe traces volatile retention in planetary formation.
CHNOPS; outside HARPS range for main N I lines. N I 7468.31 near-IR only — skip for this dataset. Priority 2: report as non-detection or upper limit.
Iron-peak; Co/Fe traces neutron excess and SNe yields. Hyperfine structure in several lines. Measurable in 55 Cnc at [Fe/H]=+0.32.
Type Ia vs. Type II SNe tracer. Cr/Fe ratio constrains SNe contribution history. Many Cr I lines in blue HARPS range.
Refractory; traces crust/mantle composition. Only 2 usable lines (Al I 6696.023, 6698.673 Å) — weak and blended in metal-rich stars. Report as best-effort; upper limit acceptable.
Bio-essential electrolyte. K I 7699 strong resonance line but near-IR; 7664 blended with telluric O2. Limited lines in HARPS range — best effort.
Primary s-process indicator; AGB enrichment history. Ba II 5853/6141/6496 Å. Isotope mixture affects line profile. Hyperfine structure required.
Light s-process (first peak); chemical clock for stellar age. Y/Ba ratio traces AGB nucleosynthesis efficiency and stellar age.
Bio cofactor (V in some enzyme systems); iron-peak nucleosynthesis tracer. Hyperfine structure important. V I lines in red HARPS range.
Odd-Z iron-peak tracer; bio-essential trace metal. Cu I 5105.54, 5218.20 Å — only 2 clean lines in HARPS range. Hyperfine structure present.
Odd-Z; Mn/Fe metallicity-dependent. Mn I lines in blue-green region. Hyperfine structure critical for accurate EW. SNe Ia tracer at low metallicity.
Light iron-peak; odd-even nucleosynthesis effect. Sc I/II several lines across HARPS range. Hyperfine structure in Sc I lines.
Stellar age/activity tracer; depleted by mixing on Gyr timescales. Li I 6707 CN blend contamination; EW is upper limit. NLTE corrections 0.1-0.3 dex required.
Primary r-process indicator; neutron star merger enrichment. Eu II 6645.127 Å main line. [Eu/Fe] traces r-process history. Very weak in solar spectrum (~2-4 mA).
Completes the Sr/Y/Ba/Zr s-process picture (first + second peaks). Zr I lines in blue HARPS range. Useful for AGB yield constraints.
Light s-process anchor (first peak). Sr II 4077/4215 strong resonance lines but in blue/noisy HARPS region. Best effort — may have large continuum uncertainty.
